fix: Size the vector from the known tile count (capped at the 16_384 limit): `let count = (i64::from(stop_x) - i64::from(start_x) + 1).max(0) * (i64::from(stop_y) - i64::from(start_y) + 1).max(0);` then `let mut tiles = Vec::with_capacity(count.min(16_384) as usize);`. Alternatively return `impl Iterator<Item = Rect>` built from `(start_x..=stop_x).flat_map(...).take(16_384)` so no Vec is needed at all.

Avoid the one-element Vec on every image paint. Move the per-tile body of the `match paint.center_slice` (lines 872-896) into a closure `let mut paint_tile = |tile: Rect| match paint.center_slice { None => canvas.image_with_sampling(paint.image.clone(), source_rect, tile, paint.sampling), Some(_) => paint_nine(&mut canvas, paint, center, tile, pixels) };` (hoisting `source_rect`/`center` out of the match), then `if repeat == crate::ImageRepeat::NoRepeat { paint_tile(destination_rect); } else { for tile in image_tile_rects(rect, destination_rect, repeat) { paint_tile(tile); } }`. Works together with the iterator change suggested for `image_tile_rects`.

Build the opaque shape once and clone the Widget handle (`Widget::clone` is one Rc clone): `let shape: Widget = CustomPaint::new(size, decoration.paint_shadow(size, &opaque)).into();` then `let blurred = Widget::blur(sigma, shape.clone());` and use `shape.clone()` in the Outer and Inner arms and `shape` in the Solid arm. Removes a second full `paint_shadow` DisplayList build for every non-normal blur style shadow in each layout.

Reserve the known final length (shadows plus up to three pushed layers) so the later `push` calls do not reallocate: `let mut layers = Vec::with_capacity(decoration.box_shadow.len() + 3); layers.extend(decoration.box_shadow.iter().map(|shadow| styled_shadow(&decoration, size, shadow)));`.
